visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a white T-shirt and blue jeans is sitting cross-legged on a light gray floor in a modern living room. In front of him is a round black robot vacuum with an attached multi-jointed mechanical arm and claw. The room has neutral-toned curtains, a minimalist wooden shelf with a framed picture, and bright, even studio lighting. (2) The camera switches to a close-up of the mechanical arm, which is successfully grasping a black sock from the floor. The man is visible in the soft-focus background, holding a smartphone and looking at the device. Various objects like a pink plush toy and a pack of tissues are scattered nearby. (3) The visual shifts to a screen recording interface overlaid on the video, displaying a first-person view from the robot's camera. The mechanical arm is shown extending and retracting to pick up the black sock. The man appears in a smaller inset or in the background, controlling the robot via his phone with a focused expression. (4) The robot vacuum moves toward a large gray and gold charging base station. The man continues to interact with the robot, attempting a more difficult task of picking up a single tissue from a large purple pack of Kirkland Interfold Design tissues. The lighting remains bright and consistent. (5) In a high-angle shot, the man tries to use the robot arm to pick up a small, thin gray stylus from the floor. He looks at his phone intensely. The arm fails to grip the thin object, and the man reacts with a disappointed facial expression, looking toward the camera. (6) The video ends with a close-up of the man's face as he laughs loudly with his mouth wide open, looking upward in an exaggerated joyful reaction. The background remains the same living room setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male narrator speaking rapidly with a bright, enthusiastic tone. An upbeat electronic pop background track plays with a steady 4/4 beat and bright synthesizer pads. A digital 'ding' sound effect highlights the opening hook. (2) As the robot arm moves, a subtle mechanical whirring sound is heard. The narrator's pitch rises as he describes the arm's functions. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect transition occurs between scenes. (3) During the tissue challenge, the BGM remains consistent while a 'successful capture' sound effect—a playful digital chime—plays when the arm grips the tissue. The narrator's speech rate remains high and engaging. (4) As the man attempts to pick up the stylus, the audio features a comedic 'fail' sound effect, similar to a slide whistle or a low-pitched horn. The narrator's tone shifts to mock-disappointment with exaggerated 'ah' sounds. (5) The final phase features loud, unrestrained male laughter and a bright, swelling synthesizer melody that concludes the track. The music fades out quickly after a final digital pop sound effect.
